fixture.position_derivation: 147 prompt tokens; generated token 12 (_we) occupies position 158 and its forward predicts generated token 13.

arms.name: tool_name_window_b96
arms.run_only_if: singleton_boundary_b96 does not return a valid get_weather call

validity: All arms use one retained executable hash and a clean implementation commit.
The official rendered prompt hash must match the frozen 147-token fixture.
The base arm must not contain a progressive-rescue marker.
Each rescue arm must contain exactly the preregistered base-position markers and no request-wide Budget96 marker.
Each arm records logical provider bytes, physical direct-read bytes, exact fallback bytes, timings, generated token IDs, response JSON and final logits hash.

gate.pass: A rescue arm returns exactly one native-valid get_weather tool call with location San Francisco without request-wide Budget96.
gate.traffic: Report total and average bytes over every provider position, plus rescue records/bytes above the H23 base table.
gate.stop: If the four-position window fails, stop positional Budget96 rescue on this fixture and investigate earlier-state or representation damage; do not widen adaptively.
gate.next_if_pass: Replace the position oracle with a grammar/tool-schema boundary trigger and rerun the same fixture plus non-tool controls.

limitations: The rescue positions are label-derived and are not a deployable risk oracle.
One tool fixture cannot establish broad reliability.
This gate does not establish the 0.53 GiB/token or 10 tok/s target.
